title: Wild Apples
author: Henry David Thoreau
description: "Wild Apples" by Henry David Thoreau is a reflective and insightful exploration of the apple tree and its significance, written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This publication combines elements of natural history, philosophy, and botany, focusing on the wild apple's cultural and ecological importance.

authorInfo.bio: Henry David Thoreau was an American naturalist essayist, poet, and philosopher. A leading transcendentalist, he is best known for his book Walden, a reflection upon simple living in natural surroundings, and his essay "Civil Disobedience", an argument in favor of citizen disobedience against an unjust state.
